homedash.home.title: Dashboards
homedash.home.empty_text: A dashboard shows your devices and the values of this server at a glance. Start with a ready-made system dashboard or with an empty page.
homedash.home.create_starter_hint: CPU, memory, disk, network and uptime of this server, live.
homedash.home.create_empty_hint: A blank page for your own layout.
homedash.home.readonly_note: This desktop is read-only. You can view dashboards but not create or delete them.
homedash.home.notice_open_failed: The dashboard could not be opened.
homedash.home.notice_list_failed: The dashboards could not be loaded.
homedash.home.notice_limit: The dashboard limit is reached. Delete a dashboard first.
homedash.home.notice_create_failed: The dashboard could not be created.
homedash.home.notice_readonly: The desktop is read-only; nothing was changed.
homedash.home.notice_delete_conflict: The dashboard was changed in the meantime. Check the list and try again.
homedash.home.notice_delete_failed: The dashboard could not be deleted.
homedash.delete.title: Delete dashboard?
homedash.delete.body: “{{name}}” and its saved versions will be removed. This cannot be undone.
homedash.view.empty_text: Widgets are added with the dashboard designer, which arrives in a later update.
homedash.banner.offline: Connection lost. The values shown may be out of date. Reconnecting…
homedash.banner.auth_lost: Your session has ended. Sign in again to see live values.
homedash.banner.source_degraded: {{source}} reports old values; they may be out of date.
homedash.banner.schema_too_new: This dashboard was saved by a newer HomeDash version and is shown as it is.
homedash.banner.readonly: Read-only desktop: dashboards can be viewed, not changed.
homedash.disabled.title: HomeDash is switched off
homedash.disabled.text: HomeDash is switched off in the AuraGo settings. Switch it on there to use your dashboards.
homedash.error.title: HomeDash could not start
homedash.error.storage: The dashboard storage could not be opened. The server log has the details.
homedash.error.generic: The server did not answer as expected ({{code}}).
